integrity: The parameter-uniform Jacobian claims are certified by exact Smith normal forms over QQ[t] and independent geometry of pairwise intersection points. Prior t=16 nearly freeness and the numerical near-free criterion are credited to Gałecka.
scientific_limitations: Only the smooth-conic subfamily t != 0 over C, characteristic zero. Not a classification of arbitrary conic-line arrangements. Possible unindexed prior calculations are not excluded.
title: Exactly two nearly-free fibers in the concentric-conic pencil of a square
